test_Crossover_mutation: test the Crossover mutation operator with FFT and real array crossover on numpy arrays
test_RavelCrossover_recombine: test the RavelCrossover mutation operator by recombining two flattened numpy arrays with a seeded random state
test_LocalGaussian_mutation: test the LocalGaussian mutation operator to apply localized Gaussian noise along specified axes of an array
test_MutationChoice: test the MutationChoice operator that randomly selects from LocalGaussian, Jumping, and Translation mutations
test_rolling_mean: test the rolling_mean utility function to compute a rolling mean over a numpy array with a given window size
